The company created a training center internally with training lab equipment where apprentices can come and train at their convenience between shifts. Matt started at Mackey as a production operator before getting into trades as a maintenance electrician and completing a four-year apprenticeship. When the company decided to start a training department internally, Matt applied for the position, which required him to teach executives on specific subjects and create training documents on how to instruct them.

Since joining the training department, Matt has built the internal training infrastructure from nothing. The apprenticeship program is still ongoing, as he notes that training never ends. The training center and lab equipment allow apprentices to develop their skills in a dedicated facility, accommodating their schedules around their shift work. This project has been the most rewarding of Matt's 26 years at Mackey.

f: Mackey hosts an annual Halloween trunk-or-treat event along its 300-yard main visitor entrance driveway leading into the visitor's parking lot. The event features an internal competition among employee departments, each creating their own themed vehicle decorations to compete for awards including best theme. Participating departments have dressed their vehicles as Wizard of Oz, Mario Brothers, and Fortnite, with some departments going particularly elaborate, such as the IT department creating a staged Fortnite experience that nearly wins every year.

The event welcomes children from the community for traditional trunk-or-treat candy collection, but with the added excitement of themed vehicles and characters throughout the entrance. To ensure fair judging and bring in outside energy, organizers have invited external judges from the community in recent years. Mackey also partners with local organizations for the event, including the Sandstone Fire Department, which brings a fire truck that allows children to climb aboard and explore.
